subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A history class watched an old newsreel from wartime.”?
options: Both versions told the truth in different ways.
A black-and-white photo showed people standing in waist-deep water on a city street.
The newsreel showed what people were told, not necessarily the whole truth.
It showed how people used stories to remember the night sky.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Both versions told the truth in different ways.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A black-and-white photo showed people standing in waist-deep water on a city street.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The newsreel showed what people were told, not necessarily the whole truth.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It showed how people used stories to remember the night sky.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
